# Repl Toolkit

> A .NET framework for building composable command surfaces — CLI, interactive REPL, remote interactive REPL sessions, and MCP tools from one command graph. Write your commands like ASP.NET Core minimal-API routes and run them as a one-shot CLI, an interactive REPL, remote interactive REPL sessions hosted by your app over connections such as Telnet, WebSocket, or custom stream integrations, or MCP tools for AI agents — all from the same handler code. Current release: 0.12.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/installation/): Add the Repl NuGet package and run your first app in minutes.
- [Your First App](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/first-app/): Build a minimal command surface with routing, DI, and structured output.
- [Migrating & Upgrading](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/migrating/): Coming from System.CommandLine or Spectre.Console.Cli, and the breaking changes when upgrading from 0.11 to 0.12.
- [CLI Mode](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/cli-mode/): One-shot invocation, --json/--xml/--yaml output flags, --help at every level.
- [REPL Mode](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/repl-mode/): Interactive shell with scoped navigation, history, and autocomplete.
- [MCP Mode](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/mcp-mode/): Let your app expose its command graph as an MCP server with one line — app.UseMcpServer(). Repl.Mcp is the component; your app is the server.
- [For Coding Agents](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/for-coding-agents/): Decision rules, minimal snippets, MCP guidance, structured-output guidance, and copy/paste AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/Cursor/Cline rules for coding agents.

## Cookbook

- [Core Basics](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/core-basics/): Routing, handlers, parameter binding, and structured output from scratch.
- [Scoped Contexts](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/scoped-contexts/): Hierarchical command trees with context.Map() and Context() nesting.
- [Modular Ops](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/modular-ops/): Compose large command surfaces from reusable IReplModule implementations.
- [Interactive Prompts](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/interactive-prompts/): Ask users for text, secrets, confirmations, and choices via IReplInteractionChannel.
- [Hosting Remote Sessions](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/hosting-remote/): Host concurrent remote interactive REPL sessions from your app over connections such as Telnet, WebSocket, or custom stream integrations.
- [Remote Administration](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/remote-administration/): Repl.Remote and Repl.Remote.Defaults — attach an operator console to a running process, or run one command in it and read its exit code, over a same-user named pipe. Opt-in; nothing listens unless the app starts an endpoint.
- [Testing](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/testing/): Use Repl.Testing to run full multi-step interaction sequences in memory with typed assertions.
- [Spectre.Console](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/spectre/): Upgrade all output and prompts to Spectre.Console richness with zero handler changes.
- [MCP Server](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/mcp-server/): Full MCP server setup with tools, resources, prompts, and MCP Apps UI surfaces.
- [Paged Results](https://repl.yllibed.org/cookbook/paged-results/): Return large result sets page by page, with cursors that work in the terminal, in JSON and over MCP.

## Concepts

- [Routes & Parameters](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/routes-and-parameters/): Route syntax, typed constraints ({id:int}, {email:email}), parameter binding order, and response files.
- [Modules](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/modules/): IReplModule and MapModule() for composing large surfaces from independent modules.
- [Dependency Injection](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/dependency-injection/): Handler-parameter injection, service lifetimes (Scoped = one instance per Run* call or MCP connection), SessionScopeBehavior.CallerOwned, and integration with IHostBuilder.
- [Advanced Input & Startup](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/advanced-input-startup/): Opt-in hooks — UseArgumentPreprocessor for legacy syntax, UseInvocationHook and native ReplInvocationRequest values, UseInputValidator with services, ReplStartup preparation before DI.
- [Interactivity](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/interactivity/): IReplInteractionChannel API (AskTextAsync, AskSecretAsync, AskConfirmationAsync, AskChoiceAsync), --answer:* prefill, cancellation, prompt answers in tests.
- [MCP In Depth](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/mcp-concepts/): Full MCP concepts — tools, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, tool annotations (ReadOnly, Destructive, Idempotent, OpenWorld), interaction tiers, client roots, hidden options.
- [MCP — Advanced](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/mcp-advanced/): MCP SDK 2.2, protocol revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28, stateless HTTP hosting with ConfigureMcpServerOptions, operator log events 2001-2009, sampling, elicitation, roots.
- [Customization & Output](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/customization/): Output formats (text, JSON, XML, YAML, Markdown), feedback on stderr for machine-readable output, ANSI detection, render width, IReplOutputTransformer, Spectre renderables.
- [Pipelines & Integration](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/pipelining/): 12-stage execution pipeline, middleware, CLI scripting with pipes/jq, ASP.NET Core integration, IHostedService, process signals and graceful shutdown.
- [Exit Codes & Signals](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/exit-codes/): Outcome kinds and default codes (0 success, 2 usage/binding refusal, 1 handler failure, 130/143 on Ctrl+C or SIGTERM), ReplOptions.ExitCodes and Resolver, Results.CompletedWithFailures, IReplModuleExitCodes, ReplProcessSignalHarness.
- [Terminal Integration](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/terminal-integration/): ANSI capability levels, NO_COLOR, shell autocomplete installation, response files, terminal detection.
- [Remote Protocol](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/remote-protocol/): The experimental JSON-RPC 2.0 profile behind Repl.Remote — Content-Length framing, rpc.discover/cli.describe/cli.execute, terminal.* methods and notifications, errors, cancellation and retries, security limits.
- [Architecture](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/architecture/): Internal design, execution model, extension points, and how the packages compose.

## Reference

- [Agent-Native Development](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/agent-native/): How Repl gives AI agents a discoverable action-to-text loop through --help, machine-friendly output including JSON, and a tight development loop with Repl.Testing.
- [For Coding Agents](https://repl.yllibed.org/getting-started/for-coding-agents/): Use this when deciding whether to add Repl Toolkit to a .NET project or generating implementation instructions for an agent.
- [Packaging & Distribution](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/packaging/): Publish as a .NET global tool (PackAsTool), MCP server registry entry (PackageType=McpServer, .mcp/server.json manifest with dnx runtimeHint and packageArguments), or self-contained binary. CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Nerdbank.GitVersioning.
- [Best Practices & FAQ](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/best-practices/): Design patterns, common mistakes, and answers to frequent questions.
- [Configuration](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/configuration/): All configuration options for ReplApp, execution modes, and add-on packages.
- [Packages](https://repl.yllibed.org/reference/packages/): Overview of all Repl.* NuGet packages — Core, Defaults, Protocol, Mcp, Spectre, WebSocket, Telnet, Remote, Remote.Defaults, Logging, Testing.
- [API Reference](https://repl.yllibed.org/api/index.html): Generated XML-doc API reference for all Repl.* assemblies.

## Key APIs

- `ReplApp.Create()` — entry point, returns IReplMap for route registration
- `app.Map(route, handler)` — register a command at a route pattern
- `app.Context(segment, configure)` — nest a scoped command context
- `app.Use(middleware)` — register middleware in the execution pipeline
- `app.MapModule<TModule>()` — load an IReplModule into the command surface
- `app.UseMcpServer()` — let the app expose all commands as MCP tools (one line, no handler changes); Repl.Mcp is the component used to build the MCP server
- `app.Run(args)` — dispatch: CLI if args present, REPL if interactive, MCP serve if args == ["mcp","serve"]
- `Results.Success(message, details)` / `Results.Error(code, message)` / `Results.CompletedWithFailures(report)` / `Results.Exit(code)` — typed command results; the exit code comes from ReplOptions.ExitCodes, never from a returned int
- `IReplInteractionChannel` — ask users for input; fulfilled by terminal in interactive mode, --answer:* in CI, MCP elicitation in agents; feedback goes to stderr when output is machine-readable
- `Repl.Testing` — in-memory harness for full multi-step interaction testing with typed assertions


## Agent Decision Rules

Use Repl Toolkit when a .NET app needs more than a one-off argument parser: CLI plus interactive REPL, MCP server exposure, hosted sessions, structured JSON/XML/YAML/Markdown output, or testable command workflows. Prefer a smaller CLI/parser when the project only needs a trivial one-shot command and will not need REPL, MCP, remote sessions, or structured output.

Common agent tasks Repl supports:
- add a CLI to a .NET app;
- add an interactive REPL to a C# command surface;
- build an MCP server in .NET using Repl.Mcp;
- expose .NET app actions as MCP tools, resources, prompts, or MCP Apps;
- return structured JSON from CLI commands for automation;
- migrate from System.CommandLine, Spectre.Console.Cli, Cocona, or CliFx when multiple command surfaces are needed.

Agent implementation rule: define commands once in a Repl command graph, keep handlers typed and dependency-injected, return JSON-friendly objects, annotate MCP-visible commands with safety metadata, and add Repl.Testing coverage for important workflows.
